source: AWS S3 pricing https://aws.amazon.com/s3/pricing/ and AWS Fargate pricing https://aws.amazon.com/fargate/pricing/ (list prices; confirm before use)
note: List on-demand prices as of price_date. UNVERIFIED against a dated screenshot; treat as illustrative until confirmed.
transfer_assumption: same-region S3<->Fargate transfer is free; no egress modeled (release consumed in-region)
s3_tier_assumption: S3 Standard first-50TB tier list price for both 1 TB and 1 PB; no volume discounts or savings plans modeled
quota_assumptions: S3 default 3,500 PUT/s + 5,500 GET/s per prefix (sharded prefixes); SQS unlimited standard-queue throughput; Fargate default vCPU quota raised to cover the configured worker pool
